purpose.zh: 低负荷练大腿前侧控制
purpose.en: Train low-load control of the front of your thigh.

text.zh: 大腿不离开椅面，小腿慢慢向前伸
text.en: Keep your thigh on the seat and slowly straighten your lower leg

text.zh: 坐在稳固无轮的椅子上，另一只脚踩地
text.en: Sit on a stable chair without wheels, other foot planted.

text.zh: 伸到接近伸直但不锁死，再慢慢放回
text.en: Extend until almost straight without locking, then lower slowly.

commonErrors.en: Kicking the leg or snapping the knee locked.

cautions.zh: 膝盖疼痛时减小幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Reduce the range if your knee hurts, and stop if the pain continues.
